title: Benchmarking Empirical Privacy Protection for Adaptations of Large Language Models

layout.note: The light-blue LLM container sits in the centre. The pretrained dataset enters from the left, a strip of four cylinders under a pink dotted region feeds it from below, and on the right an Auditor box stacked over an MIA box exchanges query and answer arrows with it.

lesson: Show a threat-model or audit setup as an actor loop: colour-coded data cylinders feed the model with a training mark, and an outside auditor icon trades dotted Query and dashed Answer arrows before verdict signs.
